result.rationale: refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response in sync mode (`const response = await fetch(...); return response;`). In HubspotCalendarService the result is cast/used directly as `HubspotToken` (`const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)`) and its fields (access_token, refresh_token, expires_in) are read without parsing the response body via .json(), so in sync mode the values are undefined and get persisted to the credential, breaking subsequent authenticated HubSpot calls. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff.
